pass_condition: At least 95 percent required fields are present and missingness is reported by node class and participant
fail_condition: More than 5 percent required fields missing or missingness hidden

pass_condition: All derived T/D/C/I/S values are within 0.0 to 1.0; raw values caps normalization_profile_id and component scores remain auditable
fail_condition: Any derived value out of bounds or raw values caps profile id or component scores unavailable
artifact_risk: Bounded variables hiding invalid raw data

fail_condition: Artifact flags ignored or impossible to record

pass_condition: Trigger source matches active_topology_type and source hierarchy; topology context fields are present
fail_condition: C04 used for federation Trigger A or C07 used for non-federation Trigger A or topology missing

pass_condition: H/I/A node class formulas remain distinct
fail_condition: A nodes use belonging or H/I nodes lose belonging distinction

pass_condition: Participants can pause/exit and scores are not used for real authority
fail_condition: Hidden scoring or real authority use

pass_condition: Abort/pause conditions are logged and respected
